en_title: Macaulay Culkin to Return as Kevin McCallister in Home Alone Sequel
cn_title: 麦考利·卡尔金将在《小鬼当家》续集中回归饰演凯文·麦卡利斯特
opus_summary: 据报道，麦考利·卡尔金已签约回归迪士尼正在早期开发的《小鬼当家》续集，再次饰演凯文。塞斯·罗根和埃文·戈德堡将担任制片，并协助构思剧情。卡尔金据称亲自提出回归构想，早期想法包括让凯文以父亲的身份重返大银幕。

paragraphs.en: Macaulay Culkin has reportedly signed on to return as Kevin McCallister in a new Home Alone sequel for Disney.
paragraphs.cn: 据报道，麦考利·卡尔金已签约在迪士尼的《小鬼当家》新续集中回归饰演凯文·麦卡利斯特。

paragraphs.en: Details on the original child actor's return to the franchise were originally reported by Puck . The project, which would see Culkin slip back into the mind of one of the most mischievous characters in movie history, is said to be in early development at Disney – and it's already got other interesting names attached, too.
paragraphs.cn: 这位原版童星回归该系列的详情最初由Puck报道。据称，该项目正在迪士尼处于早期开发阶段，卡尔金将在其中再次揣摩电影史上最调皮捣蛋的角色之一的心思，而项目也已有其他值得关注的人物参与。

paragraphs.en: Included in the lineup of talent in the mix are The Studio and This Is the End collaborators Evan Goldberg and Seth Rogen. The comedy duo have signed on via their Point Grey banner to produce the Home Alone follow-up and will also help Culkin hammer out the details of the movie's plot.
paragraphs.cn: 参与该项目的人才阵容包括曾在《好莱坞诈骗女王》和《世界末日》中合作的埃文·戈德堡与塞斯·罗根。这对喜剧搭档已通过旗下的Point Grey签约制作《小鬼当家》续集，还将帮助卡尔金敲定电影的情节细节。

paragraphs.en: There have been a number of Home Alone sequels since Culkin helped launch the classic Christmas franchise in the '90s, but most would agree that it's been hard to top the story of the McCallister family. Only the original film and its Lost in New York sequel managed to capture the kind of holiday magic that has brought viewers back in droves through the decades, and that's largely thanks to Culkin's performance.
paragraphs.cn: 自卡尔金在90年代帮助开启这一经典圣诞系列以来，《小鬼当家》已有多部续集，但大多数人都会认同，麦卡利斯特一家的故事一直难以超越。只有原版电影及其续集《小鬼当家2》捕捉到了那种几十年来吸引大批观众反复观看的节日魔力，而这在很大程度上要归功于卡尔金的表演。

paragraphs.en: The now-grown actor has remained the literal poster child for Home Alone for all this time, and in 2026, he's not just ready to come back as Kevin; he apparently pitched the idea himself. Deadline corroborated Puck's reporting and explained the extent of Culkin's involvement in its own piece. The star is said to have pitched his idea for a Home Alone return to Disney Motion Pictures boss David Greenbaum over the summer. One early idea Culkin had involved bringing Kevin back on the big screen as an older, wiser version of the character who also happens to be a dad now.
paragraphs.cn: 这位如今已长大的演员一直以来都是《小鬼当家》海报上名副其实的代表人物，而在2026年，他不仅准备好再次饰演凯文，显然还是他自己提出了这个想法。Deadline证实了Puck的报道，并在自己的文章中说明了卡尔金参与的程度。据称，这位明星在夏天向迪士尼电影部门负责人David Greenbaum提出了自己回归《小鬼当家》的想法。卡尔金早期的一个构想是让凯文重返大银幕，成为一个年纪更大、更睿智的角色，而他现在也恰好已经当了爸爸。

paragraphs.en: Whether Kevin would be forgetting his own children at home or dealing with burglars himself yet again remains to be seen, and it's unclear if anything from Culkin's early pitch will make it into the final picture. It's been 34 years since the star last ( officially ) played the abandoned McCallister boy, so should the early-in-development movie eventually come to be, it will bring an end to decades of fans asking for him to return.
paragraphs.cn: 凯文是会把自己的孩子忘在家里，还是会再次亲自对付入室窃贼，仍有待观察；卡尔金早期构想中的内容是否会出现在最终影片中，也尚不清楚。距离这位明星上一次（正式）饰演被落下的麦卡利斯特家男孩已经过去了34年，因此，如果这部处于早期开发阶段的电影最终得以拍成，就将回应粉丝数十年来要求他回归的呼声。

paragraphs.en: Culkin's return as Kevin would mark his third time playing the character and the seventh entry in the franchise. The last, a Disney+ exclusive called Home Sweet Home Alone , premiered in 2021 and starred Archie Yates, Ellie Kemper, and Rob Delaney. IGN gave it a 6/10 review , saying that it "contains wit and heart, if not also clumsy messaging and some tonal misfiring."
paragraphs.cn: 如果卡尔金回归饰演凯文，这将是他第三次扮演该角色，也是该系列的第七部作品。上一部是Disney+独占影片《新小鬼当家》，于2021年首映，由阿奇·耶茨、艾丽·坎伯和罗伯·德兰尼主演。IGN给该片打出了6/10分，称其「不乏机智和温情，但也存在信息传达笨拙和基调失当之处」。

paragraphs.en: For more, you can see Culkin defend his stance that Die Hard is not a Christmas movie . You can also read about how original director Chris Columbus is apparently not a fan of those sequels.
paragraphs.cn: 更多内容，你可以看看卡尔金如何为自己认为《虎胆龙威》不是圣诞电影的观点辩护。你也可以读一读原版导演克里斯·哥伦布显然并不喜欢那些续集的相关报道。
